newsitem.title: JAPAN: Pioneer to postpone launch of DVD players -- paper.
newsitem.headline: Pioneer to postpone launch of DVD players -- paper.

text.p: Pioneer Electronic Corp will postpone the launch of its digital video disc (DVD) players for about two weeks, a Japanese daily said on Thursday.
The economic newspaper Nihon Keizai Shimbun said Pioneer originally planned to launch its first DVD players on November 22 but has now delayed this to around December 9.
Pioneer had planned to launch two types of players on November 22.
Company officials were not immediately available for comment.
The newspaper said the company decided on the postponement because it found some problems in the players' software playing function.
Pioneer had planned to launch other types of players from early December as well but would also delay the introduction of these for about two weeks, the paper said.
The DVD is a new type of digital video system which is expected eventually to make videocasette recorders, compact discs and CD-ROMS obsolete.
Toshiba Corp and Matsushita Electric Industrial Co launched their DVD systems earlier this month.
